name: Standing Machine Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand upright facing the standing wrist curl machine with feet shoulder-width apart.
Rest the fleshy undersides of your forearms flat against the horizontal padded platform with wrists extending just beyond the front edge.
Grasp the knurled rotating roller bar using an overhand (pronated) grip with palms facing down.
Allow the weight to flex your wrists downward under control until you feel a comfortable stretch along the top of your forearms.
Extend your wrists upward toward the ceiling as high as possible without lifting your elbows off the pad.
Squeeze the forearm extensors hard at the peak contraction for 1 second, then slowly return to the starting position.
